in_hebrew.name: Candi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Candi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'kandos', meaning 'pure, clear, and clean'. In the Bible, the name Candace is mentioned as the queen of Ethiopia and a eunuch named Candace is also mentioned. In Christianity, the name Candi represents purity, innocence, and faith.

in_greek.name: Κάντι

in_latin.name: Candi
